weighting: Same seven training graphs, equal workload geometric mean; each sample compares seconds per repetition because counts differ across cases.

scope: New follow-up candidates. This is not a rerun or amendment of original twelve-choice search01 selection.
measurement: Alternate candidate/reference order within each round; keep root CPU3 serialization.
Record total process wall and worker clock separately; add optional setup/alias/observe/drop/context clocks to NEW harness versions only.
Calibration is an experiment cost decision, not a performance result; fastest new candidate may need longer confirmation.
If winner margin<3% or candidate aggregate worker sample<1ms, mark inconclusive and schedule separately frozen longer confirmation instead of retroactively extending selected samples.
Do not share/cache fixture heads between repetitions: that changes physical graph ownership.
Retain full source/ABI/oracle gates in fresh qualification, use training-only short loop while editing.
